title: Review: refactor(auth): consolidate CredentialStore and bcrypt validation
notes:
Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — Core logic is well-structured and the security-sensitive paths (bcrypt timing equalization, zeroizing) are handled correctly. The main idiom gaps are: ConfigError wrapping String instead of typed sources (filed ob4s.6), missing #[non_exhaustive] on ConfigError (ob4s.7), Vec<String> for a two-value mechanism set (ob4s.9), and the &Option<String> parameter that should be Option<&str> (ob4s.10). These are real maintainability issues, not style preferences.
Rust idiom confidence: 85% chance of missed issue. Least confident flags: the &Option<String> vs Option<&str> finding (ob4s.10) is correct but minor; the Vec<String> mechanisms finding (ob4s.9) has an engineering basis but is lower priority if no external callers deserialize the config today. Uncertainty driven by: could not see the full imap session driver to verify whether mechanisms is actually validated at runtime or only at capability advertisement time; did not read stoa_core::signing or stoa_smtp to check for additional unwrap patterns outside the in-scope files.
